VERANDAH PROPERTIES · INTERNAL REVIEW · NOVEMBER 7, 2026

Trello requests versus AppFolio records

Initial audit findings and complete board inventory. Prepared for Pamela Syvertson. This is a read-only review; no payments, accounting changes, card changes or messages were made.

The full audit is not complete. All 97 live cards are listed below, with explicit evidence and remaining checks. Of those, 95 are actionable/administrative cards and two are internal references. The 4,049 archived cards are inventoried separately and have not been independently verified. A Done or archived status is not treated as proof.
67Done cards matched to 66 distinct work-order bills
10Matching bills still show Unpaid
$10,263.81Total of those 10 unpaid bills
4,049Archived cards awaiting independent verification

What needs attention first

1. A payment request was marked Done after only entering the bill.

Card #4139 explicitly requested payment of Playero invoice 3479 for WO 52033-3. AppFolio bill 572553 shows $4,550 Unpaid. Its approval status is Approved, which is separate from payment. AppFolio also displays an expired liability-insurance record for Playero (February 17, 2021). Verify current documentation; the alert does not establish that insurance is actually absent today.

2. Invoice entry and payment need separate completion states.

The other nine unpaid bills total $5,713.81. Two are for 11573 Straits Way: $340 (WO 52361-1) and $1,490 (WO 52219-1). Some cards request review or bill entry only, so unpaid status is a follow-up—not automatically a failed task. Do not pay these automatically without normal checks.

3. Two current invoices need reconciliation with older paid invoices.

Camargo WO 51187-2 shows $1,096 of completed work and only a $100 diagnostic bill in its Bills section. Bovet WO 52110-2 has a new VP26-89 attachment alongside a previously paid $180 VP26-83 bill. Both remain in Doing. Check the new documents, approved amounts and existing postings before further processing.

4. Later instructions and duplicate requests can make a card misleading.

Westgate’s card calls for November 15, but Megan’s November 7 tenant note says December 1. Confirm the actual charge and update the instruction record. Cards #4109 and #4110 concern the same Poplar work order and map to one $80 bill; no duplicate payment was established. The two Straits bills share an invoice reference but link to different work orders—compare the underlying invoices.

5. Several important payments have supporting AppFolio entries.

Spring Leap’s $1,538.49 check 12077; Haystack’s $2,145 and Great Heron’s $2,295 deposit-transfer ACH entries; Astoria Arbor’s $315 SureVestor refund; and City Street’s $35 November charge are recorded. Remaining checks include postage, bank settlement, closeout reconciliation and property-group membership. These findings support specific steps, not blanket completion of every related request.

Completion standard recommended

For each request, specify whether completion means review, bill entry, approval, payment initiation, bank clearance, delivery, or final reconciliation. Require an AppFolio record link, amount/date, proof of any requested attachment or delivery, and a named follow-up for unfinished steps. Use “Bill entered / awaiting payment” when appropriate. Keep duplicate requests linked to one transaction.

Live-card audit register

“Marked paid” means AppFolio records a payment. It does not prove bank clearance, satisfactory work, independent invoice validation or full authorization compliance. “Not yet verified” does not mean the task was not performed. Monetary amounts below refer to the matched invoice, not necessarily the property’s full balance.

Coverage and limitations

Sources: authenticated Trello board export (4,146 cards, 1,000 most recent actions), AppFolio bill details, payment records, recurring-bill listings, selected work orders and tenant records viewed November 7, 2026. Recent bill-list searches were limited to the dates/properties displayed; absence from those lists is not proof that a transaction does not exist. The report distinguishes exact work-order matches from partial supporting records.

Remaining work includes future-dated renewal fees and reversals, corporate-advance accounting, bank stop/clearance evidence, outgoing delivery records, attachment-sharing checks, complete property closeouts and the historical archive. The export’s 1,000-action limit means older card conversations require direct review. AppFolio CSV export was blocked in this browser; verification used visible records instead. This report does not assert that all requested work has been completed.

Confidential business records · Prepared for internal use · No corrective actions executed.
